prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need performance marketing, SEO, creative/content, B2B demand gen, or brand work.

To give a useful recommendation I need a few details:
- Primary goals (lead generation, revenue/ROI, brand awareness, app installs, SEO, etc.)
- Target audience (B2B, B2C, enterprise, SMB, verticals)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget (range)
- Timeline (one-off campaign vs long-term retainer)
- Any must-have channels or services (Google Ads, Facebook/Meta, LinkedIn, organic SEO, content, analytics)
- Preferred agency size (boutique vs large/network)

How I choose agencies (what to look for)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results in your vertical
- Transparent reporting and agreed KPIs
- Client retention and references
- Team experience and senior involvement
- Pricing model and contract flexibility
- Tech stack / tooling and integration ability
- Cultural fit and communication cadence

If you share the details above I’ll:
- Recommend 4–6 San Francisco or Bay‑Area agencies that match your needs
- Give a short pros/cons summary, likely costs, and questions to ask them
- Optionally draft a short RFP or outreach email you can send

Want me to find a tailored shortlist now?
